entities.summary: Kacper Kazimierz Ciecikowski was a Roman Catholic archbishop of the Archdiocese of Mohilev from 1828 until his death in 1831. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Lutsk-Zhytomyr from 1798 to 1828 and as bishop of the Diocese of Kijów-Czernihów from 1784 to 1798.
